meta_title: About Aayush Doshi | Digital Marketer — Marketing with Aayush Doshi
meta_description: Meet Aayush Doshi, a digital marketer helping businesses grow online with SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media marketing and website development.
hero_text: I’m Aayush Doshi, a Digital Marketer passionate about helping businesses build a stronger online presence. I enjoy exploring the digital landscape, understanding audience behaviour, and developing marketing strategies that connect businesses with the right people.
hero_text_2: My focus is on combining creativity, research, and data-driven thinking to create meaningful digital experiences and business growth opportunities.

sections.label: FAQ
sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Here are some common questions about my digital marketing services, working approach, and how we can work together.

sections.heading: Have a Project in Mind?
sections.text: Let’s connect and explore how the right digital marketing approach can support your business goals.

faqs.question: Who is Aayush Doshi?
faqs.answer: I’m a digital marketer focused on helping businesses improve their online presence through SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media marketing, and other digital marketing strategies.

faqs.question: What digital marketing services do you offer?
faqs.answer: I offer SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Social Media Marketing, Content Marketing, E-commerce Marketing, Local SEO, and Website Development.

faqs.question: Do you work with businesses from different industries?
faqs.answer: Yes, I’m open to working with businesses across different industries and understanding their unique marketing requirements.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes, I’m open to collaborating with businesses in India and other countries.

faqs.question: How do you approach a new project?
faqs.answer: I start by understanding the business, its goals, target audience, and current online presence. Based on this, I identify opportunities and develop a suitable digital marketing strategy.

faqs.question: How can I get started with your services?
faqs.answer: You can get in touch through my contact form, email, or WhatsApp. We can discuss your requirements and explore the right approach for your business.

faqs.question: Do you provide customized digital marketing strategies?
faqs.answer: Yes, I believe every business has different objectives, so I focus on developing strategies according to its goals, audience, and industry.

faqs.question: How can I contact you for a project?
faqs.answer: You can visit my Contact Me page and submit an enquiry or connect with me through my available contact details.
